thread:
Alice G: Heads-up — prepping the 2026-03 model rollout. Need QA signoff on the prompt/eval gate before we open the change window.
Ben K: Which eval suite are we gating on? the customer-facing summarizer prompts?
Alice G: Yes — Summarizer_v3 prompt-set + regression metrics from the nightly run. Also want a clear pin/rollback condition.
deploy-bot: preflight-evals summary for release/2026-03-20:
  - prompt_suite: Summarizer_v3
  - checks_total: 9
  - checks_passed: 7
  - quality_delta: +1.8% (higher = worse for ROUGE-based)
  - speed_delta: -3% latency (good)
qa-bot: alert: regression above soft-threshold on reply_coherence: +2.4% vs baseline. Flagged 12 examples for manual review.
Maria S: Can you paste the 12 flagged examples? I want to triage severity before signoff.
deploy-bot: flagged_examples_url: https://internal.redwood/evals/2026-03/summarizer_v3/flags
Sam L: quick read — most failures are longer-context hallucinations. Not critical but visible to power users.
Ben K: Proposed policy: if reply_coherence delta > +2.0% we require either a pin to last stable model or a manual rollback plan with samples and mitigations. Thoughts?
Alice G: Agree. My ask: either pin to model-stable-2026-02-28 for the first 2 hours of the window, or proceed if QA gives explicit +1 signoff after manual triage.
Maria S: I can triage in 30m. If issues are low-severity I can waive pin, otherwise request pin.
EngOps: FYI change window 03/20 18:00–20:00 UTC. We can do a fast rollback job in <8m if needed. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/fast-rollback
Sam L: If pin is needed, recommend pin window = first 4h to reduce blast radius. Also add routing fallback to smaller-token model to keep tail latency under SLO.
Ben K: If we pin, what's the deploybot command?
Alice G: Use this (EngOps-approved):
```
deploy-bot pin --deployment summarizer-service --model model-stable-2026-02-28 --duration 4h --meta "qa-gate:manual-pin"
```
Ben K: Sounds good. Maria — ping when triage done and please include a sample matrix (bad/good) in the thread.
Maria S: On it. I'll post samples and my recommendation in ~35m.
deploy-bot: NOTE: preflight artifacts archived at https://internal.redwood/artifacts/summarizer/2026-03-20-preflight.tar.gz
qa-bot: reminder: include failure rate by user cohort (internal vs public) in the decision note.
Alice G: Thanks — if Maria approves, we proceed with the release and no pin. If she requests pin, EngOps will execute the 4h pin before opening wider traffic. 
Maria S: Triage complete: 12 examples reviewed — 9 are minor verbosity regressions, 3 are coherence breaks affecting title extraction. Recommendation: request pin. Severity: low-to-medium, risk to a small subset.
Ben K: I support pin. Requesting EngOps to pin and proceed with limited rollout. :thumbsup:
EngOps: Pin scheduled. Executing pin in 2m. Will post confirmation when done.
deploy-bot: action: pin applied by EngOps at 2156789038. Pin metadata: model=model-stable-2026-02-28; duration=4h; reason=qa-gate:manual-pin
Alice G: Thanks team. Move ahead with staged rollout behind pin; update release notes to mention the temporary model pin and the rollback criteria.
Sam L: I'll update the release notes and include the example matrix + mitigation plan. 
Maria S: Leaving final QA ack: approved-to-release-under-pin.
Ben K: Approved from product. Proceed.
EngOps: Release window opened at 18:00 UTC; traffic ramping at 10% -> 30% over 15m behind pin. Monitoring critical metrics.
deploy-bot: watch: reply_coherence delta now +1.1% and dropping. No further flags.
Alice G: Great — closing this thread after we confirm 1h steady-state. Thanks everyone.
